intro.title: A qualified horticulturist since the 1980s
paragraphs: David began his career in the mid-1980s in the nursery industry and is a Member of the Australian Institute of Horticulture.

He graduated in the Associate Diploma in Horticulture in 1984 at Hawkesbury Agricultural College. As a qualified horticulturist, David now specialises in water features, computer generated landscape impressions, design and construction.

steps.title: See your garden before we start

items.title: We photograph your garden
items.text: We photograph the area to be landscaped using a digital camera.
